format: four matched pairs of question and feedback-expanded state
commonPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished, readable desktop Chinese assessment QUESTION page for meetmyworld, directly matching the supplied current marketplace homepage. Single finished website screenshot, landscape 3:2, logical 1536 x 1024, flat straight-on, all edges visible. No collage, device frame, browser chrome or Figma UI.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact current homepage style and navigation shell reference. Image 2 is the product artwork reference, translucent purple glass ribbon and floating clear sphere. Both are references only, not edit targets.
Style invariants: near-black #101118 canvas, graphite #191B24 surfaces, silver-gray hairline borders, large 20–28 px radii, lavender #D8AFE9 primary pills, white #F7F3FB headings, muted gray #A8A3B4 body, restrained mint for saved state. Match the homepage's continuous rounded glass frame and slender illuminated border, muted sage glow at lower left, lavender at lower right, subtle orbital wireframe lines behind content. Clean Noto Sans SC-like Simplified Chinese. Restrained glass illustrations only in small product thumbnail/header, no giant illustration inside a question.
Keep exact homepage shell: top bar small lavender round open-world W symbol at far left, "发现", search "搜索测试、场景或关键词", moon icon, "我的空间", lavender "登录 / 注册". Same left utility icon rail and sidebar headed "我的空间", links "应用商城", "我的应用" ACTIVE with a lavender dot, "我的报告", "我的收藏", "使用帮助", lower "输入兑换码" pill. Fit shell and page in a clear grid, generous 24–32px gutters. Do not repeat the homepage slogan or product grid.
Main content: breadcrumb "我的应用 / 伴侣协作体检", discreet "退出测评" link. Product title "伴侣协作体检", category "关系情感", small "UI 预览" badge. Single-select current question, NOT a knowledge exam with correct/incorrect scoring.
Exact question copy: eyebrow "第 05 / 16 题" and "日常分工"; question "当家里有事情需要处理时，你们通常会怎么分工？"; helper "选择最贴近真实情况的一项".
Four distinct option rows/cards, clear letter and radio:
A "我先发现，也常常是我来安排"
B "说好分工后，各自完成"
C "谁看见谁处理，彼此补位"
D "很少讨论，临时再说"
B is selected using lavender border/tint and a filled radio/check, other options neutral. No right/wrong colors.
State BEFORE confirmation: progress says "已完成 4 / 16" with 25% bar; current question 05 is selected but unsaved, show small "选择尚未确认". Primary CTA "确认选择", secondary "上一题"; small text "确认后查看其他参与者的回答". No statistics, sample counts, proportions, final result or personal score before confirmation. Do not put "已保存" on current unsaved answer. Footer "趣味自测，仅供娱乐与自我观察。".
Constraints: Crisp legible Chinese, coherent single screen, exact four options, one main CTA. No payment, redemption dialog, recommendations, ad banners, avatars/comments, medical claims, invented sales or live data. This is an already redeemed assessment. Keep same product/question/selected B across all variants.

variants.name: 居中题卡
variants.directions: Layout 01 — CENTERED QUESTION CARD. A quiet compact product heading with a 64px lavender cover thumbnail, title, compact metadata; thin horizontal progress immediately below. Center one large graphite question card, about 840px wide, with spacious 30px question heading and FOUR FULL-WIDTH VERTICAL options, each about 64px high. Card footer has 上一题 left, 确认选择 right, short pending status between. The centered card is the clear focus, restrained source glass ambiance outside it. Keep room for this card to narrow and a right feedback card to expand in the matched next state.

feedbackVariants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE matching FEEDBACK-EXPANDED state of this Chinese desktop assessment website. Input Image 1 is the corresponding question page and EXACT layout/state edit target. Input Image 2 is the original marketplace homepage, supporting brand/shell reference. Preserve Image 1's brand, sidebar, outer glass frame, top navigation, product heading/artwork, question text and option ordering. Only change saved/progress/actions and reflow the question area enough to open a right-side feedback panel. This is the SAME page after confirming selected B, not a new report page.
Output one single flat desktop website screenshot, landscape 3:2 logical 1536x1024, edge-to-edge, no device frame, no collage/browser/Figma chrome. Same restrained dark graphite glass, lavender pills/selection, white Chinese headings, silver hairline borders and subtle sage/purple perimeter glow. Chinese text must be crisp, complete and easy to read.
Product remains "伴侣协作体检". Current question remains "第 05 / 16 题", category "日常分工", text EXACT "当家里有事情需要处理时，你们通常会怎么分工？". Keep all four options with B selected:
A "我先发现，也常常是我来安排"
B "说好分工后，各自完成"
C "谁看见谁处理，彼此补位"
D "很少讨论，临时再说"
AFTER server-confirmed save: "已完成 5 / 16", 31% progress; subtle mint check with "回答已保存". Remove "选择尚未确认". Primary lavender CTA becomes "下一题"; secondary "上一题"; discreet text action "修改本题". Do not put answer percentages inside the question options.
Open a separate tall RIGHT graphite-glass feedback panel adjacent to the question. This is a nonmodal panel, never covers question/actions. Panel title "群体反馈", small chevron/"收起". A conspicuous lavender "示例数据" badge near title; small subtext "以下为 UI 演示数据". A compact current-choice inset "你的选择" then "B · 说好分工后，各自完成".
Feedback SECTION 1 heading "其他人怎么选". Sample size "本题：120 份其他有效回答". Four tidy horizontal bars with option label left and percentage right:
A "我来安排" 34%
B "分工后各自完成" 41% — lavender bar, tiny "你的选择" label
C "彼此补位" 18%
D "临时再说" 7%
Bars proportional to 34/41/18/7 and sum 100. B stays highlighted even though other answers remain neutral, no winning/correct indicators.
Feedback SECTION 2 separated by a hairline, heading "已完成答卷的结论". Its own sample size "80 份其他有效答卷". Three clearly labeled proportional horizontal bars or a clean segmented bar WITH percentage labels:
"仍在探索" 30%
"逐步平衡" 45%
"相对稳定" 25%
Use muted ice-blue, lavender and sage, no extra result type or percentages. These are other completed responses, NOT the current user's conclusion.
Panel footer exact "两类样本分别统计，均不含当前答卷". Small note "你的结果将在完成测评后生成". Footer elsewhere "趣味自测，仅供娱乐与自我观察。".
Constraints: show both distribution sections and their distinct sample counts, not a personal report/radar score, not correct/incorrect answer feedback. No invented live user data, avatars, comments, medical claims, ads, checkout or private reports. Maintain readable Chinese text, sensible margins and no cropped panels. Eight outputs are four paired page states, keep this pair visually consistent.

PAIR 01: Preserve the centered product heading/thumbnail and thin top progress from Image 1. Reflow its large central vertical-options question card into a roughly 660px question card LEFT plus a 370px feedback card RIGHT. Both start under the same progress row, aligned top edges and 24px gap. Keep all four full-width VERTICAL option rows and question footer actions clearly visible. Feedback uses stacked horizontal bar charts. Shell remains identical to Image 1.
